d:
A small, playful humanoid with shimmering neon-green skin and large, expressive, wide-set golden-yellow eyes. The head features long, drooping ear-like appendages and a shock of chaotic, bright magenta hair. The body is slender and nimble with three-fingered hands and a long, thick, prehensile tail in a gradient of neon green and magenta. A small, iridescent outfit consisting of a simple fabric wrap in teal and gold.
BODY COLOR: neon-green
